summary: J-PAKE is a password-authenticated key exchange protocol. Two parties who share only a password can establish a secure channel over an insecure network without needing a PKI or a trusted third party. This document specifies the protocol.

eli5.summary: Two friends who know the same secret word can use it to build a private tunnel, without needing anyone else to vouch for them.

questions: how to do password authenticated key exchange without pki
